text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research paper focused on land use and land cover change (LULCC) prediction for the entire mainland Tanzania (national scale). It develops and applies a novel participatory scenario framework integrating stakeholder-driven qualitative and quantitative data with spatial modeling to simulate alternative future LULCC scenarios (business as usual and green economy) to 2025. The study implements ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparisons of land cover changes, explicitly maps spatial outputs of LULCC likelihood and land cover transitions, and reports quantitative metrics such as rates of cultivated land expansion and degradation areas. The modeling is spatially explicit and integrates socioeconomic and environmental data. The paper is not a review, nor is it excluded by any criteria. Thus, it meets all core inclusion criteria for national-scale spatial LULC prediction with multiple scenarios and mapped outputs.)
